categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Recodeal Interconnect System Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, sales, and service of connector products, including connectors, connector components, and modules. Its products serve multiple sectors such as new energy vehicles (NEV), energy storage, communication, industrial rail transit, robotics, and medical devices. The company offers comprehensive connector system solutions for electric and intelligent vehicles, 5G/6G communication, data centers, and emerging industries like AI and low-altitude economy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced connector technologies including high-voltage high-current connectors, battery swap connectors, liquid-cooled ultra-fast charging connectors, high-speed data connectors, RF coaxial connectors, and integrated copper cable technologies for data centers. It employs integrated R&D and manufacturing processes covering mold design, precision injection molding, stamping, machining, and automated assembly. The company also emphasizes innovation in materials, process optimization, and digitalized production management systems such as PLM, ERP, MES, and QMS.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global and domestic automotive manufacturers (e.g., BYD, Changan, NIO, XPeng, Li Auto), communication equipment providers (e.g., ZTE, Ericsson, Nokia, Samsung), and industrial clients in robotics, medical devices, and rail transit. The company serves markets in new energy vehicles, 5G/6G communication infrastructure, energy storage systems, AI and data centers, and emerging sectors like humanoid robots and low-altitude aircraft.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major production bases in Suzhou, Taizhou, and Mianyang, and overseas manufacturing facilities in the United States and Mexico. It has expanded its international presence with offices in the US and Germany and is preparing for production layouts in Europe and Southeast Asia. Overseas sales and production have grown significantly, contributing over 16% of total assets and showing rapid revenue growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: Recodeal operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of connectors and related components. It integrates upstream processes such as mold making and material processing with downstream assembly and testing, providing customized connector solutions directly to OEMs and system integrators in automotive, communication, and industrial sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-performance connectors for NEVs, 5G/6G communications, AI/data centers, and emerging industries like robotics and low-altitude economy. It invests heavily in R&D (6.09% of revenue in 2024) with a focus on liquid-cooled charging technology, integrated battery connection systems, high-speed RF connectors, and lightweight aluminum wiring. It also emphasizes digital transformation, IPD process implementation, and international standard participation to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized connector products and integrated connector system solutions to OEMs and industrial clients. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributor channels for smaller customers. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods, typically at delivery or customs clearance for exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Recodeal is positioned as a leading domestic connector manufacturer with international competitiveness, recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise. It competes with global giants like Amphenol and TE Connectivity, especially in high-end automotive and communication connectors. The company has broken foreign monopolies in 5G and NEV connector markets and holds a strong position in China’s fast-growing connector industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved RMB 2.41 billion in revenue, a 55.29% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 175.27 million, up 28.11%. Total assets grew 26.56% to RMB 4.32 billion, and net assets increased 7.82% to RMB 2.10 billion. The company’s overseas operations contributed significantly to growth, with international sales doubling. R&D investment increased by 26.91%, supporting sustained innovation and expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Recodeal emphasizes high reliability, advanced technology, and comprehensive connector system solutions tailored to customer needs in high-growth sectors like NEVs and 5G communications. Its unique value lies in integrated capabilities across electrical, optical, microwave, fluid, and data connectors, enabling one-stop solutions. The company’s strong R&D, quality assurance, and agile manufacturing provide competitive differentiation, supported by certifications and strategic partnerships with leading global customers.
